day_shape: 74 items: US sanctions Russia's VTB Bank for aiding Iran evasion and seeks $61m in crypto tied to Iran oil, IRGC claims tanker mine strike in Hormuz which CENTCOM calls false, IAEA warns of six months without inspections, second Sunni cleric killed inside Iran, Araghchi to visit Beijing Wednesday.

threads.label: Hormuz tanker incident and counter-claims
threads.summary: Iran's IRGC said the supertanker Al-Ghayyah struck sea mines and caught fire south of the Strait of Hormuz, and separately claimed a fourth MQ-1 drone was downed. CENTCOM said the Panama-flagged El Gaia had actually been hit by an Iranian missile last month and struck again this weekend by an Iranian drone off Oman.

threads.label: US financial pressure on Iran widens
threads.summary: The State Department and OFAC sanctioned Russia's VTB Bank for helping Iran evade sanctions, and US prosecutors moved to forfeit about $61 million in cryptocurrency tied to black-market Iranian oil sales. An OFAC SDN notice was published in the Federal Register the same day.

threads.label: Araghchi Beijing trip and BRICS framing
threads.summary: Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi will travel to Beijing Wednesday to meet Wang Yi, per Defa Press and the Jerusalem Post. Iran International reported debate in Tehran over Xi's BRICS call for a collective role in Gulf peace, and the government spokesman called condemnation of attacks on Iran at BRICS a diplomatic achievement.

threads.label: Houthi advance and Saudi strikes
threads.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said 13 civilians were wounded in Houthi strikes on Khamis Mushait, Abha and Taif, and the Jerusalem Post reported Israel is providing intelligence aid to Riyadh. UN teams reported around 2,300 arrivals in Djibouti fleeing the Yemen escalation, and the Jerusalem Post cast the fall of Mocha as a new phase near Bab al-Mandab.

threads.label: Sunni cleric killings in southeastern Iran
threads.summary: Sunni Baluch cleric Molavi Yousef Gorgij was shot dead outside his home in Zahedan, the second Sunni cleric killed in Iran within a week according to Iran International. The head of Iran's parliamentary National Security Commission said those responsible must be dealt with decisively.

threads.label: IDF operations in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said troops in the south Lebanon buffer zone dismantled a Hezbollah position with a tunnel shaft and a launcher holding 32 rockets left from before the ceasefire, and Northern Command said Hezbollah is trying to base within the Yellow Line. The IDF also said five Hamas operatives were killed in Gaza and a senior Fatah operative was arrested in Tulkarm.

threads.label: IDF response to 'NAZA' documentary
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir instructed the military's top legal official to examine legal action against the film NAZA, which alleges AI-assisted killing of civilians in Gaza, and ordered a probe into leaks of classified material. The IDF rejected the film's claims as false and distorted, while the Jerusalem Post scrutinised the filmmaker's ties to a Hamas-linked activist.
